items.question: Who is Qentrah built for?
items.answer: Qentrah is built for teams that need one trusted workspace for projects, assets, tasks, clients, approvals, and handoffs.

items.question: How does onboarding work?
items.answer: Teams can start with the workspace, then map their project, asset, client, calendar, and organization flows with the Qentrah team when deeper setup is needed.

items.question: Can different teams work from the same data?
items.answer: Yes. Qentrah is designed around shared project and asset context so operators, client teams, and partners can act from the same verified records.

items.question: How is pricing handled?
items.answer: Pricing starts with the published plans on this page. Larger teams can contact Qentrah for an implementation conversation around organization structure, workflows, and support.

items.question: What makes the workspace trustworthy?
items.answer: The product keeps roles, statuses, approvals, media, and operational records close to the work, so teams can see what is ready, blocked, pending, or synced before moving forward.

icloud.valueProp: Seamlessly bind Apple iCloud Drive folders to your Qentrah listings. Upload floor plans, HD asset photos, or contract PDFs on your Mac and see them sync instantly into the workspace pipeline.

scopes.read: Allows Qentrah to read listing media, PDF blueprints, and client-submitted photos directly from your iCloud folders.
scopes.write: Allows Qentrah to automatically back up signed sales contracts, brokerage disclosures, and invoices directly into your iCloud Drive directory.

icloud.videoTitle: Tutorial: Syncing Apple iCloud Drive with Qentrah Listings
icloud.screenshotTitle: iCloud Sync Status - Live Pipeline Preview

calendar.valueProp: Automatically sync showing slots, client viewing appointments, and open-house calendar events in Qentrah directly to your macOS Apple Calendar. Never double-book another listing showing.

scopes.read: Retrieve client bookings and personal appointments on your Apple Calendar to show precise availability slots on listing pages.
scopes.write: Create, schedule, and update workspace inspection events and client showings directly into your Apple Calendar.

calendar.videoTitle: Demo: Workspace Schedules with iCloud Calendar

contacts.valueProp: Bridge the gap between your workspace CRM database and your local macOS Contacts book. New customer leads added inside Qentrah will automatically populate in your contacts list with matching labels.

scopes.read: Enables reading client contact cards to quickly resolve CRM details or import phone number lists.
scopes.write: Enables pushing brokerage phone numbers, buyer/seller profiles, and showing lead contact sheets directly to your local Apple contacts directory.

contacts.videoTitle: Overview: Managing Leads & Contacts on macOS Devices

spotlight.valueProp: Search your entire workspace listing portfolio, including active buildings, assets, task descriptions, and clients, directly from your local Mac Spotlight search (Cmd + Space) using high-velocity local indexing.

scopes.write: Allows Qentrah to register lightning-fast local search descriptors for your asset inventory and active clients directly into your Mac OS search catalog.

spotlight.videoTitle: Demo: Local Spotlight Search for Qentrah Listings
